name: Voxel Picking via Face Normal Detection
definition: Determines the voxel coordinates intersected by a raycast by transforming the pick point into local mesh space and identifying the hit face based on which axis has a zero fractional offset.
summary: Voxel Picking via Face Normal Detection determines voxel coordinates by identifying the hit face through zero fractional offsets in local space, distinguishing it from spatial hashing or simple ray-box intersection methods.
